name: FWA World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: Held by Steve Gunn at the start of 1997's own newsletter profile; changed hands to King 3933540$ Perfect in a three-fall streetfight/Texas Death/I Quit main event refereed by a guest Sandman, inside a four-week window this collection can date no more finely.
notes: FWA's own newsletter and PPV recap (promotions/fwa-association/archive/).

name: FWA North American Championship
epitaph: Held by "Ass Kicker" Adam Anderson as of the held record's February 1997 holdings; no title change survives.

name: FWA United States Championship
epitaph: Held by Malice through the held record's February 1997 holdings, including a bloody barbed-wire successful defense against "Gangsta" Crush's own challenger status turned aside -- Malice retained, though the match ends with a mystery attacker cutting his throat open on the top rope.

name: FWA Cruiserweight Championship
epitaph: Held by "Lionheart" Adam Lash as of the held record's February 1997 holdings; no title change survives.

name: FWA World Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Held by Masters of Destruction (Psycho Sabu & Master Blaster) as of the held record's February 1997 holdings; no title change survives.
